units.source_text: 源氏公子加冠之后，赴休息室，换了成人装束，再上殿来，向皇上拜舞。

en.t: After Prince Genji came of age, he went to a retiring room, changed into adult attire, then returned to the hall and performed a ceremonial dance of homage before the emperor.

units.source_text: 观者睹此情景，无不赞叹流泪。

en.t: All who watched the scene praised it with admiration and were moved to tears.

units.source_text: 皇上看了，感动更深，难于禁受。

en.t: When the emperor saw this, he was even more deeply moved and could hardly bear it.

units.source_text: 昔日的悲哀，近来有时得以忘怀，而今重又涌上心头。

en.t: The grief of former days, which he had lately been able to forget at times, now surged up in his heart once more.

units.source_text: 此次加冠，他很担心，生怕源氏公子天真烂漫之风姿由于改装而减色。

en.t: For this coming-of-age ceremony, he had been very anxious, fearing that Prince Genji's innocent and radiant charm might be diminished by the change of dress.

units.source_text: 岂知改装之后，越发俊美可爱了。

en.t: But after the change of dress, Genji became all the more handsome and endearing.
